name: SK Hynix
day_summary: Saturday — KOSPI closed. No official SK Hynix trading. Last confirmed close: ₩2,764,000 on June 19 (third consecutive ATH). Two major developments emerge on the weekend: (1) SK Hynix officially confirmed the shipment of 12-layer HBM4E samples to major AI customers via the SK Hynix Newsroom — specifications: 48GB capacity, 16Gbps per pin, 20%+ power efficiency improvement over the prior generation; this is the official product-launch confirmation, not just a supply-chain rumor; (2) The SK Hynix market cap briefly crossed ₩2,000 trillion won (at the June 19 intraday ATH of ₩2,891,000), shrinking the valuation gap with Samsung Electronics to less than ₩100 trillion for the first time in company history. Additional developing story: ₩75 billion buyback buzz (Zerohedge/Bloomberg reports) — a buyback announcement in Q3 2026 would be an incremental multiple-expansion catalyst. The week in review: SK Hynix gained +28.56% in the week ended June 19, extending the YTD gain to +308%. The next KOSPI session is Monday June 23 KST (opens 09:00 KST = 00:00 UTC June 23). The primary week-ahead catalyst: sell-side PT revisions from the 38 analysts who still carry a consensus average PT of ₩2,690,000 — the stock has been above consensus for three sessions; Goldman Sachs and BofA PT revisions to ₩3.0M+ are the next accumulation catalyst.
